scope: Diagnosis of draft upload metadata rejection, not native or final release acceptance
observed_receipt_error: Release must be the specified draft, tag, and exact source commit
cause: The root release agent patched target_commitish without tag_name and checked the source but omitted the tag check. A subsequent GET showed an untagged draft name. The publisher correctly refused this mismatching draft before uploads.
correction: Explicitly patched tag_name, target_commitish, draft and prerelease together; independent GET confirmed v0.6.22/a5ebaa5/draft before rerunning only failed publisher job.
